id.description: Node identifier. For non-root nodes, MUST equal parent + '.' + <local-name>

parent.description: Parent node ID. Omitted for the 20 root department nodes.

spawned_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when node was created

pipeline_manifest_ref.description: Pointer to bot's manifest.json#transformation_pipeline (resolvability check only)

pipeline_validated.description: Whether the bot's transformation pipeline has been validated by its own validator

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key issued at node creation by registry

key_issued_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when key was issued

key_revoked_at.description: Timestamp when key was revoked (if applicable)
